verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or community reports specifically addressing Zulip Cloud's free-tier plan limits or whether message history is preserved without upgrading; only self-hosting/export-import and general FOSS claims are present, none of which confirm free-tier history retention. Missing for 10: explicit pricing page details on free plan message retention, any comparison of free vs paid tier history limits, and confirmation this applies to Zulip Cloud (not just self-hosted).
